proposals.evidence: Turner distinguishes saṁvaraṇa putting in order, with Gujarati sāvarṇi broom, from saṁvaraṇa enclosure. Nimadi sarɔṇi matches the broom noun with contracted medial v; this is an explicitly regional comparison, not a claim that every eastern s/h broom word shares this origin.
